cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:223.team: 160 - Classen Curve - Sur La Table, 5854 N Classen Blvd, Oklahoma City, OK 37027
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:223.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Chef Instructor, Pastry at Sur La Table, you are the in-store expert and advocate for all things baking and pastry arts. You deliver #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, by sharing specialized knowledge in pastry techniques, baking fundamentals, and personalized instruction that supports all company initiatives. The Chef Instructor, Pastry plays a key role in inspiring a love for baking while driving sales of bakeware, mixers, and decorating tools through hands-on pastry classes and engaging culinary instruction. Key Responsibilities Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. · Deliver an exceptional in-store culinary experience focused on pastry and baking classes that reflects Sur La Table’s passion for food, teaching, and high standards, while following the provided recipes and game plans to ensure consistency and quality. · Communicate technical concepts and advanced pastry skills in a clear, encouraging, and approachable manner. · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. Sales & Business Performance · Drive sales by upholding kitchen standards, encouraging second class sign-ups through strong customer engagement, and promoting retail items used or featured in class. · Deliver class revenue goals by ensuring high enrollment, positive reviews, and guest return rates. · Consistently meet or exceed culinary program goals by delivering exceptional classes that drive customer engagement and sales. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as second-class sign-ups, retail culinary product sales, and guest feedback through Google reviews. Team Engagement & Store Support · Assist in setting up and breakdown of classes including organizing mise en place, prepping ingredients, and cleaning workstations. · Clean and sanitize dishes and equipment promptly to ensure smooth kitchen operations. · Assist with restocking, organizing, and maintaining kitchen supplies and tools to support overall store readiness. Operations & Compliance · Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations. · Properly handle all tools, ingredients, and kitchen equipment to maintain a safe and efficient work environment. · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses. · May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Model and ensure consistent adherence to all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs). flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.description: Company overview: Fathem is a privately held, early-stage technology company pioneering the use of artificial intelligence, physics and hardware to transform the way we see biology. FL109 was conceived by Flagship Pioneering, which brings the courage, long-term vision, and resources needed to realize unreasonable results. Become part of our mission-driven team and help envision the future of science. About the Role The Director of Sales will be responsible for driving customer acquisition, building strategic partnerships, and delivering revenue growth across our VaaS, SaaS, and platform offerings. This is a hands-on leadership role for a commercially fluent structural biologist or technical sales leader who can operate as both strategist and executor. You will own a defined bookings target, lead end-to-end customer engagement, and act as the commercial “mini-CEO” for client relationships. In addition to revenue ownership, you will shape Fathem’s market development and outreach strategy, from identifying and cultivating prospective customers to leading participation in key industry events and creating high-impact content that builds awareness and engagement. This is a builder role: best suited for a commercially fluent leader who thrives on creating structure, establishing customer relationships, and developing scalable business systems in an emerging market. Key Responsibilities Revenue & Commercial Ownership Own and exceed annual bookings and revenue targets for Fathem’s commercial offerings. Build and manage a qualified pipeline from prospecting through close, leveraging CRM data to ensure forecast accuracy. Hold pricing and commercial terms authority within defined guardrails; manage forecasts and deal reviews with leadership. Negotiate and structure agreements that create long-term value for customers and for Fathem. Partner with Finance and Operations to align delivery plans with revenue recognition and margin goals. Report regularly on pipeline health, deal progress, and revenue performance to leadership. Customer Acquisition & Partnership Development Identify, engage, and nurture new customers across pharma, biotech, and the Flagship ecosystem. Develop tailored account strategies to expand adoption and drive repeat business. Build and maintain trusted executive-level relationships with customer stakeholders. Represent Fathem externally at key meetings, conferences, and industry events. Market Development & Outreach Develop and oversee Fathem’s external engagement strategy, including targeted outreach, event participation, and partnership visibility. Partner with leadership and external vendors to execute campaigns, manage event logistics, and track lead conversion. Develop and maintain a calendar of high-impact scientific and commercial events aligned with Fathem’s growth priorities. Contribute to content creation and thought leadership efforts that build Fathem’s brand presence across industry channels and social media. Manage a modest budget for event participation and outbound initiatives, prioritizing efforts with the highest commercial impact. Customer Insight & Market Feedback Capture key learnings from customer and partner engagements to refine Fathem’s value proposition and go-to-market approach. Collaborate with the Product and AI teams to share structured insights that inform product strategy and prioritization. Represent customer perspectives in internal discussions to ensure solutions align with market needs. Commercial Infrastructure Partner with a part-time CRM consultant to finalize implementation, ensure data integrity, and establish effective reporting. Own the commercial use and adoption of the CRM system to drive visibility, forecasting accuracy, and pipeline health. Define and track key growth metrics and reporting cadence for leadership review. jobgether-jobgether:lever:674d32c7-4855-.title: Global HR Business Partner
jobgether-jobgether:lever:674d32c7-4855-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Global HR Business Partner based in the United States. This role serves as a strategic bridge between HR and business leaders across a global organization. You will act as a trusted advisor on people strategy, talent decisions, organizational effectiveness, and employee matters. The position combines hands-on HR partnership with broader change management and talent initiatives. You will collaborate with leaders and HR specialists across talent acquisition, development, operations, benefits, compliance, and policy. Success in this role requires strong business acumen, sound judgment, and the ability to navigate complex and changing environments. You will help shape people programs, identify organizational risks, and create solutions that support both employees and business goals. This is an influential opportunity for an experienced HR professional who enjoys working across functions, cultures, and geographies. Serve as a strategic HR partner and trusted advisor to leaders, helping shape and execute people-management strategies aligned with business objectives. Lead the people-management agenda for assigned business functions and facilitate discussions around organizational priorities, talent, performance, and employee matters. Identify high-potential and key employees, develop talent plans, support succession planning, and identify opportunities for career progression and cross-functional development. Build strong, credible relationships with internal stakeholders and proactively identify organizational gaps, people risks, and opportunities for improvement. Drive enterprise talent-management processes throughout the year, supporting employee growth, organizational development, and business performance. Develop and implement talent and people programs tailored to business needs while maintaining alignment with broader HR practices, policies, and standards. Partner with HR subject-matter experts across talent acquisition, talent development, HR operations, benefits, compliance, policy, and people data to deliver effective solutions throughout the employee lifecycle. Manage complex HR initiatives and change-management projects, including related communications and organizational adoption activities. Provide guidance on HR policies, employment practices, local regulations, and best practices while balancing organizational requirements with employee needs. Support employees as a knowledgeable, empathetic, and service-oriented point of contact, helping resolve complex issues and achieve positive outcomes. Monitor organizational culture and employee sentiment, identify emerging concerns, and proactively recommend appropriate interventions. Bring business and employee feedback to HR specialists to continuously improve people programs and future program development. Communicate complex or sensitive HR information clearly and effectively to employees and leaders. Maintain strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and adapt quickly across multiple competing initiatives. Requirements 5+ years of experience partnering with business leaders in a global HR capacity, with exposure to areas such as payroll, benefits, DEI, performance management, talent management, and employee development. Professional HR experience supporting employees and organizations in both the United States and Mexico. Fluency in both English and Spanish. Strong knowledge of HR processes, employment practices, applicable laws, and organizational best practices. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-priority projects and competing deadlines in a dynamic environment. Strong business acumen with the ability to establish credibility, trust, and effective partnerships at all organizational levels. oriongroup-oriongroup:greenhouse:4705822.title: Human Resources Manager, Air Comfort Service Group
oriongroup-oriongroup:greenhouse:4705822.description: Human Resources Manager Full-Time Onsite – West Babylon, NY Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM As the Human Resources Manager, you will play a key role in leading day-to-day HR operations, champion our team members, and keep our organization compliant, supported, and running smoothly. This role thrives on variety, takes pride in getting the details right, and is a trusted partner to both leadership and team members. What You’ll Do Lead day-to-day HR operations and coordinate departmental goals, processes and programs. Drive companywide recruiting, hiring, and onboarding to attract and retain top talent. Support performance management, team member reviews, and professional development initiatives. Manage weekly payroll processing, including rates, taxes, deductions, and quarterly and year-end filings. Administer benefit programs, insurance plans, and COBRA, including renewals and enrollment. Ensure compliance with federal and state HR laws, EEO/Affirmative Action plans, prevailing wage, and required reporting. Oversee OSHA, safety, and training requirements, along with Workers’ Compensation administration and reporting. Maintain compliance with union and collective bargaining agreements. Maintain the Employee Handbook, process documentation, and the Learning Management System (LMS). Safeguard confidential information and uphold the company’s Confidentiality Agreement. What You Bring Education & Experience: High School diploma or GED with 5-8 years of HR related experience. SHRM certification – SHRM-CP or SHRM-SCP (preferred). Proven ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced environment. Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. A collaborative, team-oriented approach. Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook. Compensation & Benefits • Pay Range: $125k-$150k • Medical insurance • Paid Time Off + 11 Paid Holidays • 401(k) with Company Match up to 4% #LI-LL1

summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.description: IMPORTANT - REQUIRED NEXT STEP As part of our hiring process, all applicants are required to complete the Predictive Index (PI) Behavioral Assessment. The PI Behavioral Assessment is not a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits, and Perks - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we want? We seek a dedicated individual that is looking to advance their leadership opportunity. This individual must possess a high drive to win while maintaining the integrity to do the right thing. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You will manage a team of highly trained, optimistic Advisors, Operators, and Attendants to provide exceptional guest service in a fun, interactive atmosphere. We need an enthusiastic leader that has experience in management, and a willingness to learn the car wash industry. Location: Russell Speeders Car Wash Fairfield County, CT

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:83caa4a9-141.description: Overview Help shape how AI understands and speaks Canadian French. We're launching a short-term project that needs English (UK) speakers based to review, rewrite, and create French text that trains AI language models. You'll work from home on a flexible schedule. What you'll do Read AI-generated French responses and rate them for accuracy, grammar, and cultural fit Rewrite weak responses into clear, natural Canadian French Compare two AI answers side-by-side, pick the better one, and explain why Write your own French prompts and example responses to expand our training data Flag answers that miss Canadian French cultural context or local references Who we're looking for Fluent in English (UK), with strong written grammar and a good ear for tone A background in teaching, writing, editing, or translation is a plus, not a requirement Ready for structured, repetitive review work and meeting daily quality targets Project details Start date: Immediate Duration: 4 weeks Hours: ~20 hours per week, flexible schedule Job type: Freelance contract Location: Remote Rate: $38/USD Note: Please do not use VPNs or IP-masking tools during the recruitment process — our security system requires accurate regional verification.
